description: Rank counties in the lower 48 states on weighted measures, with the same scoring as the site's My priorities. Rank 1 has the lowest concern score. Counties with missing data are left out, never scored as low. Optional limits and state filter. Read the cautions in every answer.

count.description: How many counties to return. Default 10.

key.description: Measure key from list_measures or find_measure, for example "crime:violent-crime".

max.description: Leave out counties above this raw value.

min.description: Leave out counties below this raw value. Ignored when max is also given.

min_population.description: Leave out counties with fewer residents than this (Census ACS 2019-2023). Small counties have unstable rates; 10000 or more is a common choice.

state.description: State name, postal code or 2-digit FIPS.

name: rank_counties
